reasons.correctness: Port, properties, adapter and service match the interface exactly. Case-insensitive lookup and PLN=1 are handled. HALF_UP to 2 decimals. The missing-rate error carries the key and ISO code. Build green, 5/5 hidden tests.
reasons.convention_fit: ExchangeRatePort sits in currency/port and FixedExchangeRateAdapter in currency/adapter. The service depends only on the port and uses an explicit constructor. It throws BusinessRuleTranslatableException, and the key is in both messages_en and messages_pl.
reasons.design_fit: Cohesive split: the adapter normalises keys once, the service only multiplies and rounds, and the rates are bound through a properties class like RegistryProperties. One small risk: Collectors.toMap throws on case-duplicate keys.
reasons.test_quality: Two MockitoExtension unit tests, no Spring context. They cover exact and case-insensitive lookup, PLN not configured, unknown currency, rounding including the 0.005 boundary, and the exception key and args. 7/7 pass.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries found Port/Adapter/Properties exemplars, the TranslatableException classes, TESTED_BY edges and the currency package before any edit. The agent then read VatRegistryPort, BialaListaVatAdapter and their test and mirrored them.
